verdict.rationale: The evidence shows pieces of the story but no unified global search launcher. Walker is shipped, though it is documented only for clipboard history. File fuzzy-finding exists via the fzf `ff` alias, but only in the terminal. Settings are reached through the keyboard-driven Omarchy Menu rather than a search box. missing for 10: an evidenced global launcher that searches apps, files and settings in one place, a documented launcher hotkey, any claim of instant search speed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
